# pi-durable-telegram

> An always-on, durable pi agent on your own server that you talk to in Telegram. Open-source (MIT) Telegram gateway for pi-durable (`@earendil-works/pi-durable`), the durable agent harness from the pi project. Conversations live in SQLite; after a crash or restart an unfinished run resumes and its answer is still delivered to the chat, exactly once.

Setup in three steps on the server: install pi (`curl -fsSL https://pi.dev/install.sh | sh`), `/login` in pi to any provider, then `pi install git:github.com/smixs/pi-durable-telegram` and run `/skill:pi-durable-telegram`; the skill asks for a bot token, finds the user's Telegram id and installs the systemd service.

Key facts:

- Package: `pi-durable-telegram`, installed with `npm install -g https://github.com/smixs/pi-durable-telegram/releases/latest/download/pi-durable-telegram.tgz` (GitHub release archive); CLI `pi-durable-telegram run | login <provider>`; also a library (`createTelegramChannel`) and a pi package with a setup skill (`pi install git:github.com/smixs/pi-durable-telegram`).
- Runtime: Node.js 22.19+, Linux with systemd (user service), long polling (no webhook, domain or HTTPS needed).
- Model: any provider pi supports; defaults to pi's default provider, model and thinking level, else Anthropic `claude-opus-5-5` with `high`. Credentials are shared with pi (`~/.pi/agent/auth.json`, under pi's own lock), so `/login` in pi is the only login.
- Telegram: private chats with allow-listed user ids only; streaming answers by editing one message; queueing while busy; commands `/new`, `/stop`, `/compact`, `/status`, `/help`.
- Files: photos and documents up to 20 MB saved to `<workdir>/inbox/`; the agent sends files back (up to 50 MB) with `telegram_send_file`; voice notes transcribed with Deepgram nova-3 when `DEEPGRAM_API_KEY` is set.
- Tools: `bash`, `read` (text and images), `write`, `edit` in `PI_WORKDIR` under the service user; secrets are stripped from the shell environment.
- Durability: each model turn, tool call and Telegram delivery step is committed before it is shown; redelivered Telegram updates are deduplicated; a data-directory lock keeps one owner per storage.
